## Appearance

Jonas has a large, loose-jointed figure distinguished by absurdly long legs. He features lank, tow-colored hair, green eyes, and a big mouth.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010)_

## Personality

Jonas is known for his ability to make decisions quickly. However, this decisiveness can create an uncomfortable dynamic within a shared household.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Confidences P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025)_

## History

Jonas Blake was a theological student from St. [Columbia](../codex/places.md#columbia) who had graduated from [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Prior to pursuing the ministry, he had spent a long time attempting to follow a different career path because he initially did not want to become a minister.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 ch.Jonas P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 ch.Jonas P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)_
